baseline_dependency.role: historical integration baseline only; current authoritative add-on version is 1.3.2 analytical-final

baseline_authority_rule: The baseline remains authoritative outside the narrow topics adjudicated here. This add-on supplements rather than replaces baseline JSON. If an add-on record conflicts with baseline on one of the specifically audited topics, flag for human review; do not silently overwrite.

material_loss.scope: standing durable/material physical loss and damage as of analytical cutoff; temporary burial/inaccessibility is not automatically full replacement-equivalent loss; unsupported destroyed-UAS airframe counts are excluded

munitions_expenditure.rule: Authoritative separate accounting product. All bounds use the same Feb. 28–Mar. 31, 2026 6,770-launch scope and a date-compatible composition derivation from UAE, Bahrain and Israel itemized splits. Do not substitute later conflict-wide depletion percentages for this cutoff.

leadership_records.rule: Preserve person-level records and political/state versus military/security categorization; aggregate only as a derivation.

legacy_archive_only.label: LEGACY PARTIAL SUBSET — ARCHIVAL / BACKWARD-COMPATIBILITY ONLY
legacy_archive_only.rule: Never use as headline, current total, current floor, subtotal, central estimate, or upper envelope.

source_files_for_other_accepted_topics.iranian-claim-evolution.json: claims.json as canonical proposition-level add-on records
source_files_for_other_accepted_topics.claim-taxonomy.json: do not replace canonical disposition vocabulary
source_files_for_other_accepted_topics.ENGINEER-RESEARCH-PROMPT.md: research completeness specification for the remaining day-by-day Iranian corpus

implementation_rule: Keep controlled disposition and estimative judgment separate. Use the completed bounded estimates in the authoritative current-loss files. PENDING_ESTIMATE is an active-research state only and is not a release-side answer for categories modeled in this package.
